steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: This topic covers key vocabulary and structures for prepositions and conjunctions. You need to know the topic vocabulary, be able to use it in all four skills (listening, speaking, reading, writing), and express opinions with reasons.

steps.title: GCSE Spanish Exam Tips
steps.body: Por vs para is a common exam topic: por = reason/cause, para = purpose/destination. Use prepositions correctly after verbs (depender de, pensar en). Use conjunctions to link ideas and create complex sentences. Use connecting words for fluency.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about prepositions and conjunctions. | Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on prepositions and conjunctions. | Translate into Spanish: "I think prepositions and conjunctions is important because..."

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Four sentences using topic vocabulary, with correct adjective agreement, articles and verb conjugation. Include at least two different tenses for Higher tier. | A structured paragraph with: introduction (en mi opinión...), opinion with reason (creo que... porque...), a different viewpoint (sin embargo...), and a conclusion (en conclusión...). Use connecting w | "Creo que [topic] es importante porque..." — ensure adjective agreement (masculine/feminine), correct verb form, and give a specific reason.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Use a range of tenses (present, preterite, imperfect, future) to access higher marks Include opinions with reasons (creo que... porque...) Check adjective agreement (gender and number) before finishing Use complex structures: negation (no...nada, no...nunca), pronouns (lo, la, los, las), conjunctions (sin embargo, además, por eso) Include cultural references to Spanish-speaking countries For writing: plan your response, check verb conjugations, re-read for errors
